puzzles.opening: The Black Cat. I killed someone. As the police led me away, I saw a black cat staring at me from the doorway. At that moment, I realized I was wrong.
puzzles.answer: I had been feeding the cat downstairs. Returning from a business trip, I found dead mice on my balcony and blamed a neighbor with whom I often argued. I killed the neighbor. As the police took me away, I saw the cat carrying a mouse and realized it had brought the mice.

puzzles.opening: A man is found dead in the desert, lying headfirst in the sand. Several suitcases are scattered nearby. In his hand, he is tightly clutching half a matchstick. How did he die?
puzzles.answer: He and his friends were traveling in a hot-air balloon when it developed a problem and began losing altitude. They threw their luggage overboard, but the balloon was still too heavy. They drew matchsticks to decide who would be sacrificed. The man drew the broken matchstick and was thrown out of the balloon, still holding it.
